typed-decision-audit.title: Typed Decision Models: An Early Evidence Audit and Evaluation Checklist

note.en: Independent early audit of 28 papers; finds latency and cost evidence but no independent accuracy advantage for typed readout, with only nine days of evidence.

knowledge-triage-paper.title: The Compaction Cliff in Long-Running AI Agent Memory

note.en: CIKM 2026 paper reporting type-aware compaction, decomposition, and retrieval results; independent replication was not found.

note.en: Study of 14 models and three corrupted tool classes; reports corrupted-return adoption above one third for every tool and 68% for web search.
note.ja: 14モデルと3種類の破損ツール出力を調べた研究。全ツールで破損出力の採用率が3分の1を超え、ウェブ検索では68%と報告。

note.en: Preprint separating pre-generation memory validity, identity resolution, abstention, and serving latency; reported stale-exposure figures are study-specific.

nber-writing-shipping-code.title: NBER Working Paper 35275: From Writing Code to Shipping Software

note.en: Independent working paper measuring coding activity, projects, and releases; observational results and public/open-source scope limit causal transfer.
note.ja: コーディング活動、プロジェクト、リリースを測る独立ワーキングペーパー。観察研究と公開・オープンソース中心の範囲が因果転移を制限する。

demirer-writing-shipping-code.title: From Writing Code to Shipping Software author PDF

note.en: Author-hosted paper copy used to inspect the release-attenuation analysis; it remains observational evidence.
note.ja: リリース減衰分析を確認する著者公開論文。観察証拠である。

fiona-jellyfish.title: Jellyfish: AI coding and review bottlenecks

note.en: Independent paper reporting increased review time and downstream bottlenecks; proprietary observational evidence limits generalization.
note.ja: レビュー時間増加と下流ボトルネックを報告する独立論文。非公開データによる観察証拠で一般化に限界がある。

note.en: First-party implementation of an explicit agent-facing interface; interoperability and safety remain untested here.
note.ja: 明示的なエージェント向けインターフェースの一次実装。相互運用性と安全性はここでは未検証。

note.en: First-party implementation of an agent-facing interface for interaction with a social surface; operational boundaries remain unverified.
note.ja: ソーシャル面との対話を行うエージェント向けインターフェースの一次実装。運用境界は未検証。

note.en: First-party Chrome documentation for WebMCP and browser agent-facing interfaces; availability and host constraints remain material.
note.ja: WebMCPとブラウザのエージェント向けインターフェースに関するChrome一次資料。提供範囲とホスト制約が残る。

note.en: Practitioner report used as anecdotal evidence of an agent-facing escape path, not an independent implementation in this category.
note.ja: エージェント向け脱出経路の逸話的証拠として扱う実務家報告であり、本カテゴリの独立実装ではない。

note.en: Independent university report describing PROTEA defenses against hidden trigger-word behavior in AI-powered robots.
note.ja: AI搭載ロボットの隠れたトリガー語挙動へのPROTEA防御を記す大学の独立報告。

note.en: First-party threat and control guidance for agentic systems; coverage is guidance, not independent effectiveness proof.
note.ja: エージェントシステムの脅威と制御に関するTenuo一次ガイダンス。独立した有効性証明ではない。

note.en: First-party open implementation of agent security controls and policy enforcement.
note.ja: エージェントセキュリティ制御とポリシー強制の一次公開実装。

note.en: Canonical first-party repository for an autonomous offensive-security workflow; it is adversarial case evidence, not a defensive control or independent efficacy proof.
note.ja: 自律型攻撃セキュリティworkflowの正規一次リポジトリ。防御制御や独立した有効性証明ではなく、敵対的case証拠として扱う。

note.en: First-party architecture report used as lifecycle-convergence evidence, not a separate Radar signal.
note.ja: ライフサイクル収束の証拠として扱うMeta一次アーキテクチャ報告。独立レーダー項目ではない。

note.en: First-party report used as lifecycle monitoring convergence evidence, not a separate Radar signal.
note.ja: ライフサイクル監視の収束証拠として扱うOpenAI一次報告。独立レーダー項目ではない。

note.en: Practitioner architecture essay used as lifecycle-design convergence evidence, not a separate implementation claim.
note.ja: ライフサイクル設計収束の証拠として扱う実務家アーキテクチャ論考。独立実装の主張ではない。

trailofbits-regression-review.title: Your AI agent fixed the bug, but what else did it change?

note.en: First-party review of more than 130 merged agent-assisted security patches, 21 confirmed regressions, and the preliminary regression-hunt comparison.
note.ja: 130件超のマージ済みエージェント支援security patch、21件の確認済み回帰、regression-huntの予備比較を扱う一次レビュー。

note.en: First-party public implementation of a structured, evidence-gated regression investigation workflow.
note.ja: 構造化され証拠ゲートを持つ回帰調査workflowの一次公開実装。

note.en: First-party project page for the live symmetric attack-and-defense benchmark.
note.ja: live対称攻防benchmarkの一次project page。

cyberarena-paper.title: CyberArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Live Symmetric Attack-and-Defense Combat

note.en: Primary paper reporting 12 agents, 40 challenges, and 466 adaptive attack-and-defense matches.
note.ja: 12 agent、40 challenge、466件の適応的攻防matchを報告する一次論文。

note.en: Sibling implementation using graph-based test-impact analysis; project-run results report lower test regressions on bounded SWE-bench Verified samples.
note.ja: graph型test-impact分析を使う同等実装。限定SWE-bench Verified標本でtest回帰低下を報告するproject実施結果。

note.en: First-party public implementation and artifacts for TDAD.
note.ja: TDADの一次公開実装とartifact。

openai-coding-eval-audit.title: Separating signal from noise in coding evaluations

note.en: Independent benchmark-validity challenge reporting that roughly 30% of SWE-Bench Pro tasks were broken.
note.ja: SWE-Bench Pro taskの約30%が壊れていたと報告する独立benchmark妥当性検証。

patchbench-paper.title: PatchBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Vulnerability Patching

note.en: Independent challenge showing PoC-only validation can overstate vulnerability-patching success and miss root-cause or semantic failures.
note.ja: PoCのみの検証が脆弱性patch成功を過大評価し、root causeや意味的障害を見逃し得ることを示す独立検証。

aaif-four-projects.title: AAIF announces Agent Skills, Open Responses, OpenEnv, and OpenSandbox

note.en: First-party foundation announcement covering four separately scoped projects and their contributed governance; it does not establish interoperability, isolation quality, or adoption outcomes.
note.ja: 範囲の異なる4プロジェクトと寄贈後の統治を示す財団の一次発表。相互運用性、隔離品質、採用成果を証明するものではない。

anthropic-agent-skills-aaif.title: Anthropic donates Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation

note.en: First-party governance announcement and vendor-reported integration, publication, and installation counts; the counts lack an independently auditable denominator or task-outcome measure.
note.ja: 統治変更と、統合・公開・導入数に関するベンダー報告。数値には独立監査可能な分母やタスク成果測定がない。

github-customization-usage-metrics.title: Custom skills, agents, and MCP servers in GitHub usage metrics

note.en: First-party telemetry change exposing configured names and longer usage lists; GitHub warns that client telemetry can undercount and should be used for trends rather than exact accounting.
note.ja: 設定名とより長い利用一覧を公開する一次telemetry変更。GitHubはclient telemetryが過少集計し得るため、正確な会計ではなく傾向把握に使うよう注意している。

note.en: First-party implementation of sandbox, policy, provider-credential, gateway, and extension layers; public code is concrete but does not independently validate containment.
note.ja: sandbox、policy、provider資格情報、gateway、extension層の一次実装。公開codeは具体的だが、封じ込めを独立検証しない。

note.en: First-party release evidence for configuration delivery, conformance work, identity and Landlock tests, and observability changes; it is not a security certification.
note.ja: 設定配信、conformance、identity・Landlock試験、observability変更の一次release証拠。security認証ではない。

note.en: First-party control and limitation documentation: deny-by-default egress, Landlock and seccomp enforcement, immutable static controls, and a best-effort mode that can continue with reduced filesystem restrictions.
note.ja: 既定拒否egress、Landlock・seccomp強制、静的制御の不変性、filesystem制限が弱いまま継続し得るbest-effort modeを記す一次制御・制約資料。

agent-compute-engine-deep-dive.title: Google Agent Compute Engine deep dive

note.en: First-party architecture for persistent, pausable microVM workspaces, external credential mediation, and restricted networking; preview timing and scale claims remain vendor-reported.
note.ja: 永続・休止可能なmicroVM workspace、外部資格情報仲介、制限networkingの一次architecture。preview時期と規模主張はvendor報告のまま。

nvidia-sentry-runtime.title: Inside NVIDIA Sentry: Secure AI Agents at Runtime

note.en: First-party design for BlueField-hosted inspection, policy enforcement, runtime context, and protected records; planned availability and efficacy are not independently validated.
note.ja: BlueField上のinspection、policy強制、runtime context、保護記録の一次設計。提供予定と有効性は独立検証されていない。

note.en: First-party local VM implementation with no host mounts, scoped secrets, default-deny networking, explicit transfer, and candid hypervisor, egress, credential, and trusted-image limits.
note.ja: host mountなし、限定secret、既定拒否network、明示transferと、hypervisor、egress、資格情報、信頼imageの限界を明記するlocal VM一次実装。

note.en: First-party microVM, network, workspace, and credential boundaries plus explicit warnings about direct mounts, broad allowed domains, shared skills, and host-side MCP servers.
note.ja: microVM、network、workspace、資格情報境界と、direct mount、広い許可domain、共有skill、host側MCP serverの注意点を示す一次資料。

kubernetes-agent-sandbox-docker-sbx.title: Kubernetes Agent Sandbox Docker sbx example

note.en: Sibling integration showing identity, storage, scheduling, per-agent microVMs, egress policy, and external credentials, while documenting privileged-pod and credential-at-rest limitations.
note.ja: identity、storage、scheduling、agent別microVM、egress policy、外部資格情報を組み合わせ、privileged podと保存資格情報の限界も記す同等実装資料。

note.en: Project-authored failure-injection surface for stale reads, ambiguous outcomes, phantom success, and related trajectory faults; artifact identity and independent outcome evidence remain limited.
note.ja: stale read、曖昧な結果、phantom successなどのtrajectory障害を注入するproject作者資料。artifact identityと独立成果証拠は限定的。

note.en: Vendor-authored repeated crash-analysis comparison; useful case evidence, but several dumps lack ground truth and the results are not an independent benchmark.
note.ja: vendor作者による反復crash分析比較。case証拠として有用だが、一部dumpにground truthがなく独立benchmarkではない。

note.en: First-party report of model-written, kernel-checked proofs with explicit semantic, assumption, and property-scope boundaries; not evidence of general bug freedom.
note.ja: model生成・kernel検査proofを、semantic、仮定、property範囲の境界とともに示す一次報告。一般的な無欠陥性の証拠ではない。

note.en: Published proof artifacts for bounded verification targets; machine checking strengthens evidence only within the encoded model and theorem scope.
note.ja: 限定verification対象の公開proof artifact。machine checkが強める証拠は符号化modelとtheorem範囲内に限られる。

note.en: First-party programmable prompt, tool, UI, and lifecycle interception surface; mods execute with Claude Code machine access and require review and pinning.
note.ja: prompt、tool、UI、lifecycleをprogrammableにinterceptする一次surface。modはClaude Codeのmachine accessで動くためreviewとpinが必要。

note.en: Public operator UI for concurrent sessions, agent trees, and needs-you state; no independent outcome study is attached to the product.
note.ja: 並行session、agent tree、needs-you状態の公開operator UI。製品固有の独立成果研究は付属しない。

note.en: Public local monitor, replay, alerts, and experimental orchestration contract; standardization and conformance claims lack independent implementations.
note.ja: local monitor、replay、alert、実験的orchestration contractの公開実装。標準化とconformance主張には独立実装がない。

note.en: Public debugger and profiler connecting model requests, tool calls, processes, waits, critical paths, resource use, and run comparison.
note.ja: model request、tool call、process、wait、critical path、resource use、run比較を結ぶ公開debugger・profiler。

note.en: Independent controlled HCI study reporting higher short-task throughput and one additional supervised agent, but no significant improvement in perceived control or redirection.
note.ja: 短時間task throughput向上と監督agent 1件追加を報告する独立HCI対照研究。ただし知覚controlやredirectには有意改善なし。

note.en: First-party continuously addressable between-commit edits and conversation-linked work state; portability and cross-runtime replay remain project claims.
note.ja: commit間editと会話連結work stateを継続的にaddress可能にする一次資料。移植性とruntime横断replayはproject主張のまま。

note.en: Project release evidence for cross-session observation capture, summaries, retrieval, and progressive recall; independent outcome and poisoned-state evidence is absent.
note.ja: session横断observation capture、summary、retrieval、progressive recallのproject release証拠。独立成果とpoisoned-state証拠はない。

note.en: Early protocol for mandates, budgets, signatures, degradation, receipts, and tiered memory with a conformance suite; adoption and interoperability are unproven.
note.ja: mandate、budget、signature、degradation、receipt、階層memoryとconformance suiteの初期protocol。採用と相互運用性は未証明。

note.en: First-party collaboration-state and trust model with role-governed rooms and stored event records; independent portability evidence is absent.
note.ja: role統治roomと保存event recordによるcollaboration state・trust modelの一次資料。独立した移植性証拠はない。

note.en: First-party readiness boundary listing missing service components such as KV-cache infrastructure, disaggregation, and cross-replica load balancing.
note.ja: KV-cache基盤、disaggregation、replica間load balancingなど未実装service componentを示す一次readiness境界。

note.en: First-party speculative-decoding implementation and reported performance; gains require workload-matched reproduction and correctness checks.
note.ja: speculative decoding実装と性能報告の一次資料。gainにはworkload一致の再現とcorrectness checkが必要。

note.en: First-party model and engine compatibility constraints, including patched serving builds and narrow qualification; licensing and deployment fit require review.
note.ja: patched serving buildと限定qualificationを含むmodel・engine互換制約の一次資料。licenseとdeployment fitのreviewが必要。

note.en: Mature sibling inference and serving implementation used to bound DeepInfer and EAGLE readiness claims.
note.ja: DeepInferとEAGLEのreadiness主張を限定する成熟した同等inference・serving実装。

note.en: Mature sibling serving implementation with broader model and deployment surfaces than the newly observed artifacts.
note.ja: 新規観測artifactより広いmodel・deployment surfaceを持つ成熟した同等serving実装。

snowflake-snowpr.title: SnowPR: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Snowflake’s 43-Million-Line Monorepo

note.en: First-party methodology for 65 merged-change tasks across a private Java/C++ monorepo, graded by the hidden tests that shipped with each change; REM is internal and the task set is too small to resolve narrow gaps reliably.
note.ja: privateなJava/C++ monorepoの65件のmerged changeを、各変更と共に出荷されたhidden testで採点する一次methodology。REMはinternalで、task数は小さな差を安定判別するには不足。

note.en: First-party benchmark update emphasizing inferred intent, larger changes, blocking merge criteria, and broader repository coverage; tasks and grading remain privately curated by Cognition.
note.ja: 意図推論、大規模変更、merge blocker、repository範囲拡大を重視する一次benchmark更新。taskと採点はCognitionのprivate curateのまま。

ibm-scarfbench-kaggle.title: IBM and Kaggle launch leaderboard for Java framework migration

note.en: First-party account of an open, Kaggle-reproduced 204-task Java migration benchmark that checks build, startup, and behavior and reports runtime failures behind plausible generation or compilation.
note.ja: build、startup、挙動を検査し、もっともらしい生成・compile後のruntime failureを報告する、openでKaggle再現済み204-task Java migration benchmarkの一次説明。

note.en: Independent construct-validity audit: credits private anti-contamination and maintainer rubrics, but argues that diff-only grading omits social and ecosystem inputs to real merge decisions and that private artifacts constrain falsifiability.
note.ja: 独立construct-validity監査。private化によるcontamination耐性とmaintainer rubricを評価する一方、diffのみの採点は実際のmerge判断に必要なsocial・ecosystem情報を欠き、private artifactが反証可能性を制限すると指摘。

note.en: Independent sibling implementation running all 132 private tasks three times with the Stirrup harness; confirms that published results are model–harness–judge configurations rather than model-only measurements.
note.ja: 132件のprivate taskをStirrup harnessで各3回実行する独立sibling実装。公開結果がmodel単体ではなくmodel–harness–judge構成の測定であることを確認。
